title: Shiva Ashtakam
intro: Shiva Ashtakam is a hymn dedicated to Lord Shiva, glorifying His supreme greatness, compassion, and divine form.
description:
Prabhum Prananatham Vibhum Vishwanatham
Jagannatha Natham Sadananda Bhajam |
Bhavadbhavya Bhuteshwaram Bhutanatham
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||1||

Gale Rundamalam Tanau Sarpajalam
Mahakala Kalam Ganesadi Palam |
Jatajute Gangottarangai Vishalam
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||2||

Mudamakaram Mandanam Mandayantam
Maha Mandalam Bhasma Bhushadharam Tam |
Anadim Hyaparam Maha Mohamaram
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||3||

Vatadho Nivasam Mahattattahasam
Mahapapa Nasham Sada Suprakasham |
Girisham Ganesham Suresham Mahesham
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||4||

Girindratmaja Sangrihitarvdheham
Girau Sansthitam Sarvadapanna Geham |
Parabrahma Brahmadibhir-Vandymanam
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||5||

Kapalam Trishulam Karabhyam Dadhanam
Padambhoja Namraya Kamam Dadanam |
Balivardamanam Suranam Pradhanam
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||6||

Sharachchandra Gatram Gananandapatram
Trinetram Pavitram Dhanashasya Mitram |
Aparna Kalatram Sada Sachcharitram
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||7||

Haram Sarpaharam Chita Bhuviharam
Bhavam Vedasaram Sada Nirvikaram |
Shmashane Vasantam Manojam Dahantam
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meshanamide ||8||

Svayam Yah Prabhate Narashshula Pane
Pathet Stotraratnam Tvihaprapyaratnam |
Suputram Sudhanyam Sumitram Kalatram
Vichitraissamaradhya Moksham Prayati ||

|| Iti Shri Shivashtakam Sampoornam ||

faq.a1: Shivashtakam is traditionally attributed to the great philosopher and saint Adi Shankaracharya.
faq.q2: What is the meaning of the repeating refrain in Shivashtakam?
faq.a2: The concluding line of each verse translates to: "I praise and worship Lord Shiva, Shankara, Shambhu, and Ishana."
faq.q3: What are the benefits of reciting Shivashtakam?
faq.a3: According to the final verses, reciting it every morning grants a good son, abundant grains, loyal friends, a virtuous spouse, and ultimately guides the devotee toward Moksha (liberation).
faq.q4: When is the best time to recite Shivashtakam?
faq.a4: As stated in the text itself ("Prabhate"), it is ideal to recite it early in the morning right after waking up and completing morning ablutions.
faq.q5: What aspects of Lord Shiva's divine form are highlighted in this hymn?
faq.a5: The stotram vividly describes Lord Shiva’s ascetic and cosmic attributes—wearing a garland of skulls and serpents, carrying the Ganges in His matted locks, smeared with sacred ash, dwelling in cremation grounds, and manifesting as the supreme conqueror of death (Mahakala).
